string-array.name: municipalities_array
string-array.item: Beijing is the capital of China and one of the country\'s most important historical and cultural cities. It is located in northern China and has served as the capital during several periods of Chinese history. Beijing is famous for landmarks such as the Forbidden City, the Temple of Heaven, and the Summer Palace. The Great Wall can also be visited in areas near the city. Beijing is an important centre for government, education, technology, and international communication. The city combines traditional architecture with modern buildings and transport systems. Its cultural attractions and historical sites welcome visitors from around the world.

Shanghai is a major city located on the eastern coast of China, near the mouth of the Yangtze River. It is one of the country\'s leading centres for finance, business, transportation, and international trade. Shanghai is famous for its modern skyline, especially the buildings in the Pudong district. The Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower are well-known landmarks. The Bund is another popular attraction, offering views of historic buildings and the Huangpu River. Shanghai also has a rich cultural heritage, traditional gardens, museums, and busy shopping streets. The city plays an important role in China\'s economic development.

Chongqing is a municipality located in southwestern China. It is known for its mountainous landscape, rivers, and distinctive urban architecture. The city lies near the meeting point of the Yangtze River and the Jialing River. Chongqing is an important transportation and industrial centre in western China. It is also famous for its spicy hot pot, which is a popular part of local food culture. Hongya Cave is one of the city\'s best-known tourist attractions. Chongqing has many bridges, steep roads, and modern buildings that reflect its unique geography. The municipality also includes rural areas and beautiful natural scenery.

Tianjin is a municipality located in northern China, southeast of Beijing. It is an important port city and transportation centre near the Bohai Sea. Tianjin has played a significant role in China\'s modern commercial and industrial development. The city is known for its mixture of traditional Chinese architecture and historic European-style buildings. Popular attractions include the Tianjin Eye, the Ancient Culture Street, and the Five Great Avenues. Tianjin is also famous for local foods such as Goubuli steamed buns. Today, the city continues to develop its manufacturing, education, technology, and international trade while preserving many historical and cultural attractions.
